title: Intent Skills & Flows: known jobs run as versioned Skills with inspectable Flows; one clarification; result as context

problem.user_segment: practising physicians (cardiology and pediatrics first; all six launch specialties keep the generic path)
problem.job: ask one professional question and get the right execution without choosing agents, sources or workflows
problem.observed_failure: every request was planned the same way: «что изменилось в рекомендациях» did not compare versions, «препарат при заболевании — что сейчас известно» returned a bare instruction, follow-ups started unrelated runs and ambiguous requests were guessed
evidence: «Эмпаглифлозин при ХСН-сФВ — что сейчас известно?» on b5317b5: drug_reference without the Russian guideline or the society guideline
«Какие новые рекомендации по ХСН-сФВ?» on b5317b5: no ESC 2026 summary, no research
a follow-up «Оставь только российские источники» minted a new unrelated run

hypothesis: If repeated jobs run as evaluated Skills with evidence-dependent Flows, ambiguous requests get one bounded question and follow-ups patch the open result, physicians get more complete answers for the same input with fewer reformulations, without losing any module, source or provenance the generic path had.
kill_criteria: a Skill result loses a module or an answering source the generic path had
an unsupported claim reaches the page
a clarification is shown twice for one request
a Skill id, Flow id or step list is rendered as navigation or copy
cardiology evidence appears in a pediatric Skill result
